services.name: Live Music Sunset Sail Child Rate
Dolphin Watch & Historical Harbor Sail
services.desc: Cruise and sail through the historic harbors near Vilano Beach, as we seek out some of Saint Augustine’s most charming residents, the local dolphin population. We’ll view local bottlenose dolphins as they frolic, feed, and engage in their natural behaviors. Guests will enjoy unobstructed views of the nation’s oldest city from the perfect vantage point, on the water. Fury’s state-of-the-art 65’ Sailing catamaran provides 360-degree views, as guests roam the spacious deck and open air cabin enjoying complimentary sodas, water, beer and wine. This adventure is perfect for cosmopolitans and Embark on an aquatic adventure with Fury’s Saint Augustine Dolphin Watch & Historical Harbor Tour!

services.name: Live Music Sunset Sail
services.desc: From November 15th - January 11th reserve Live Music Sunset Sail at : [Live Music Sunset Sail & Nights of Lights Viewing](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/furystaug/items/566161/?full-items=yes&flow=1223518) Discover your Saint Augustine story aboard Fury's spacious state-of-the-art catamaran. Leave your worries behind as you take in the beautiful city of Saint Augustine basked in the glow of sunset. Indulge in complimentary beer, wine, soda, water, margaritas, champagne, and a variety of snacks, while enjoying live performances by some of the city's favorite musicians! Join hands with Join Fury for a unique Saint Augustine Sunset Celebration!

blurb: Guests board a spacious catamaran to experience dolphin watching, historical landmark cruises, live music sunset sails, and special holiday-themed sails. Tours include snacks and beverages, with some offering alcoholic drinks for purchase or complimentary. The tours provide views of St. Augustine's historic sites and wildlife, with knowledgeable crew and family-friendly atmospheres.

quotes.text: Our family had a blast on a Fury St. Augustine Sunset Sail. The crew was professional AND fun, the drinks and snacks were endless, the music and dancing were perfect for our family and the scenery was beautiful. Thank you for helping us make special memories.
Thanks Fury, for a wonderful water tour of St. Augustine. We had a blast with Captain Howard and James. You both shared knowledge of the city's history and wildlife. We will be back!!
